chunks.text:
# About Kestrel and how to contact us

Kestrel Cycle Club was founded in 2019 by two bike mechanics, Ines Duarte and Tomas Wren, who wanted to make electric bikes affordable without the cost of buying one. We started with 40 bikes from a workshop on Harbour Street. Today we look after about 3,200 bikes across Port Aven, Millbrook and Saltmarsh, and every one is serviced in our own workshop.

## Getting help

The quickest way to get help is the chat in the app, which is answered by our support team from 7:00 to 22:00 every day.

chunks.text:
The quickest way to get help is the chat in the app, which is answered by our support team from 7:00 to 22:00 every day. We aim to reply within 15 minutes. You can also call us on +353 21 555 0142 from 8:00 to 20:00 on weekdays and from 9:00 to 17:00 at weekends. Emails to help@kestrel.example are answered within one working day.

For breakdowns, always use the help line in the app, because it shows us where you are.

## The depot

Our depot and workshop is at 14 Harbour Street, Port Aven. It is open Monday to Saturday from 8:00 to 18:00 and closed on Sundays. You can drop off a bike for service, return a bike, collect a spare battery or try the K2 cargo bike before switching plans.

## Complaints

If you are not happy with how we handled something, reply to any support message with the word Complaint. A team lead will reply within three working days. If we cannot agree, you can take the complaint to the Port Aven Consumer Board, which is free.

# The app and your account

The Kestrel app runs on iPhone and Android. You use it to manage your membership, book services, swap batteries and get help.

## Signing in

Sign in with your email address. We send a six-digit code instead of using a password. The code expires after ten minutes. You can turn on two-step sign-in under Account, then Security, which also asks for a code from an authenticator app.

## Unlocking the bike without the key

If you forget your key, you can unlock the frame lock from the app.

# The app and your account

The Kestrel app runs on iPhone and Android. You use it to manage your membership, book services, swap batteries and get help.

## Signing in

Sign in with your email address. We send a six-digit code instead of using a password. The code expires after ten minutes. You can turn on two-step sign-in under Account, then Security, which also asks for a code from an authenticator app.

## Unlocking the bike without the key

If you forget your key, you can unlock the frame lock from the app.

chunks.heading: Unlocking the bike without the key
chunks.text:
If you forget your key, you can unlock the frame lock from the app. Stand within two metres of the bike, open the bike screen and hold the unlock button for three seconds. This needs Bluetooth to be switched on. The chain lock still needs the key.

## Payment details

Change your card under Account, then Payment. The new card is used from the next payment. Invoices for every payment are under Account, then Invoices, and can be downloaded as PDF files, which is useful if your employer pays for your bike.

## Sharing the bike

Only the member may ride a Commuter, Weekender or Annual Commuter bike. On the Family plan you can add one more adult rider from the same address under Account, then Riders. The second rider gets their own sign-in but cannot change the membership.

## Your data

The app records rides only to show you your distance and to find the bike if it is stolen. Ride history is kept for 12 months and then deleted. You can download all your data or ask for it to be deleted under Account, then Privacy.

# Bikes and batteries

Kestrel has two bikes. Both have a motor that helps you pedal up to 25 km/h, hydraulic disc brakes, built-in lights and a frame lock.

## The K1 city bike

The K1 is a light step-through bike for commuting. It weighs 22 kg, has seven gears and fits riders from 155 cm to 195 cm tall. The battery gives a range of about 70 km in the standard assist mode and 45 km in boost mode. The rear rack carries up to 25 kg.

## The K2 cargo bike
chunks.embedText:
# Bikes and batteries

Kestrel has two bikes. Both have a motor that helps you pedal up to 25 km/h, hydraulic disc brakes, built-in lights and a frame lock.

## The K1 city bike

The K1 is a light step-through bike for commuting. It weighs 22 kg, has seven gears and fits riders from 155 cm to 195 cm tall. The battery gives a range of about 70 km in the standard assist mode and 45 km in boost mode. The rear rack carries up to 25 kg.

## The K2 cargo bike

chunks.heading: The K2 cargo bike
chunks.text:
## The K2 cargo bike

The K2 has a long front box with a bench and seat belts for two children up to six years old, or room for about four shopping bags. It weighs 38 kg and has a stronger motor for hills. Its range is about 55 km with an empty box and 40 km fully loaded. A rain cover for the box is included with the Family plan.

## Charging

Each bike comes with a charger that plugs into any normal wall socket. The battery unlocks with the same key as the bike and can be taken inside to charge.

## Charging

Each bike comes with a charger that plugs into any normal wall socket. The battery unlocks with the same key as the bike and can be taken inside to charge.

chunks.heading: Charging
chunks.text:
The battery unlocks with the same key as the bike and can be taken inside to charge. A full charge from empty takes about four and a half hours. Charging to 80% takes about three hours, which is enough for most days.

The battery lasts longest if you keep it between 20% and 80% and charge it at room temperature. Do not charge it below 0 °C or leave it in direct sun on a hot day.

chunks.heading: Battery swap stations
chunks.text:
## Battery swap stations

If you run low while you are out, you can swap your battery for a full one at any of our six swap stations, including the central depot on Harbour Street and the station at Port Aven Central. Scan the QR code on the locker with the app, put your battery in, and take the charged one that unlocks. Swaps are free and unlimited for every plan.

## Riding in cold weather

Lithium batteries hold less charge in the cold. Below 5 °C, expect about a quarter less range than usual. Keeping the battery indoors overnight and fitting it just before you ride helps.

# Delivery and returns

We bring your bike to your door, set it up, and show you how everything works.

## Where we deliver

We deliver anywhere in Port Aven and the towns of Millbrook and Saltmarsh. Delivery inside Port Aven is free. Delivery to Millbrook or Saltmarsh costs €15, charged once with your first payment. We do not deliver to the islands yet.

## Delivery times

Choose a delivery slot when you sign up. The earliest slot is usually two working days later.

## Delivery times

Choose a delivery slot when you sign up. The earliest slot is usually two working days later.

chunks.heading: Delivery times
chunks.text:
The earliest slot is usually two working days later. Slots are two hours long, between 8:00 and 20:00 on weekdays and between 9:00 and 17:00 on Saturdays. There are no deliveries on Sundays or public holidays. You can change your slot in the app until 18:00 the day before.

## At the handover

The rider must be at the handover to sign for the bike and show photo ID. The person delivering adjusts the saddle and handlebars to your height, pairs the bike with your app and takes you for a short test ride. Allow about 20 minutes.

# Memberships and prices

Kestrel Cycle Club rents electric bikes by subscription in Port Aven. Every membership includes the bike, a lock, a charger, servicing and theft cover. You choose a plan when you sign up and can change it at any time.

## Plans

| Weekender | €15 a month | K1 city bike, Friday to Monday only | Weekend trips |

chunks.heading: Deposit

There is no deposit for the Commuter, Weekender and Annual Commuter plans. The Family plan has a refundable deposit of €100, because the cargo bike costs more to replace. The deposit is returned within 10 working days after the bike comes back undamaged.

## Changing your plan

You can move to another plan from the app under Account, then Membership. An upgrade starts straight away and you pay the difference for the rest of the month. ## Pausing your membership

chunks.heading: Pausing your membership
chunks.text:
## Pausing your membership

If you are away, you can pause your membership for up to two months in each calendar year. You keep the bike at home or return it to the depot, and you pay nothing while it is paused. A pause must be at least seven days long. Pauses are not available on the Annual Commuter plan, because it is already discounted.

## Cancelling

Monthly plans can be cancelled with 14 days' notice from the app. We collect the bike on or after the last day, and your final payment covers the notice period.

# Repairs and maintenance

Servicing is included in every membership. You never pay for wear and tear, such as brake pads, tyres, chains or bulbs.

## Regular service

Every bike gets a free full service every six months. We send a reminder in the app two weeks before it is due. A mechanic can service the bike at your home in a two-hour slot, or you can drop it at the depot on Harbour Street and pick it up the same day. A service checks the brakes, gears, tyres, lights, battery health and frame, and takes about 45 minutes.

## Booking a repair

chunks.heading: Booking a repair
chunks.text:
## Booking a repair

If something stops working between services, open the app and choose Report a problem. Add a short description and a photo if you can. Most repairs are booked within two working days. If the bike cannot be ridden safely, we lend you a replacement bike while yours is fixed.

## Flat tyres and roadside help

Our roadside team fixes flat tyres and other breakdowns anywhere inside the ring road. Call the help line from the app and a mechanic will reach you within 90 minutes between 7:00 and 21:00.

# Riding rules

These rules keep you safe and keep your theft and accident cover valid.

## Who can ride

Riders must be at least 16 years old. Members must be 18 or over to sign the agreement, so a parent or guardian signs for riders aged 16 or 17. There is no upper age limit.

## Helmets and lights

Port Aven law does not require helmets on electric bikes that stop helping above 25 km/h, but we strongly recommend one. Every membership can add a helmet for €3 a month. The lights switch on automatically when it gets dark and must not be covered.

## Loads and passengers

## Loads and passengers

chunks.heading: Loads and passengers
chunks.text:
## Loads and passengers

The K1 city bike is for one rider only. The rider and their luggage together may weigh up to 120 kg, and the rear rack takes up to 25 kg. The K2 cargo bike can carry up to 200 kg in total, including the rider, and up to two children aged six or under in the box with their seat belts fastened. Child seats on the rack are not allowed on either bike.

## Where you can ride

Ride on roads and cycle lanes. Riding on pavements is not allowed in Port Aven, except where a sign shows a shared path.

chunks.heading: Where you can ride

Riding on pavements is not allowed in Port Aven, except where a sign shows a shared path. Kestrel bikes must not be used off road, in races, or on beaches, because sand and salt water damage the motor.

## Changes to the bike

Do not change or tune the motor, the speed limit or the battery. Simple accessories that clip on, such as a phone holder, a basket or panniers, are fine. Anything that needs tools, such as a different saddle, must be fitted by our mechanics.

# Theft and accidents

Every membership includes cover for theft. Accidents are rare, but it helps to know what to do before one happens.

## If your bike is stolen

Report the theft to the police and get a crime reference number. Then report it in the app within 24 hours of noticing it missing, and add the reference number. If the bike was locked with the frame lock and the supplied chain lock to a fixed object, you pay a theft excess of €80 and we deliver a replacement bike within three working days.

chunks.heading: If your bike is stolen
chunks.text:
If the bike was locked with the frame lock and the supplied chain lock to a fixed object, you pay a theft excess of €80 and we deliver a replacement bike within three working days.

If the bike was not locked with both locks, or you report the theft more than 24 hours late, the excess is €400. Every bike has a GPS tracker, so we can sometimes recover it. If we find it undamaged within seven days, the excess is refunded.

## If you have an accident

First make sure you and everyone else are safe, and call 112 if anyone is hurt.

chunks.heading: If you have an accident
chunks.text:
First make sure you and everyone else are safe, and call 112 if anyone is hurt. Take photos of the scene and the bike, and swap names and contact details with anyone else involved. Do not ride the bike again until it has been checked, even if it looks fine: a crash can damage the frame or the brakes in ways you cannot see.

Report the accident in the app within 48 hours. We collect the bike, check it and lend you a replacement in the meantime.

## Who pays

chunks.heading: Who pays
chunks.text:
## Who pays

Kestrel's insurance covers damage to the bike whatever caused the accident, minus the damage charges listed on the repairs page when the accident was your fault. It also covers your legal liability up to €1,000,000 if you injure someone or damage their property while riding a Kestrel bike. It does not cover your own injuries, so we recommend personal accident insurance.

## Lost keys and locks

A lost key costs €25 and we post you a new one within two working days. If you lose the chain lock, the replacement costs €35.

chunks.text: If you lose the chain lock, the replacement costs €35. Until the new lock arrives, keep the bike indoors, because the theft cover needs both locks.
